Author:     Rob Lemley <rob@thunderbird.net>

    Bug 1921310 - Port bug 1920970: Use node-modules toolchain for eslint CI tasks. r=aleca
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D223839

diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/source-test/mozlint.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/source-test/mozlint.yml
index f1afe0e331c..4974027d6d6 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/source-test/mozlint.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/source-test/mozlint.yml
@@ -47,8 +47,7 @@ eslint:
         using: run-task
         cwd: '{checkout}'
         command: >
-            cp -r /build/node_modules_eslint node_modules &&
-            cp -r /build/node_modules_eslint-plugin-mozilla/ tools/lint/eslint/eslint-plugin-mozilla/node_modules &&
+            cp -r $MOZ_FETCHES_DIR/node_modules node_modules &&
             ln -s ../tools/lint/eslint/eslint-plugin-mozilla node_modules &&
             ln -s ../tools/lint/eslint/eslint-plugin-spidermonkey-js node_modules &&
             ./mach commlint -v -l eslint -f treeherder -f json:/builds/worker/mozlint.json comm/
@@ -57,6 +56,7 @@ eslint:
     fetches:
         toolchain:
             - linux64-node
+            - node-modules
 
 file-perm:
     description: Check for incorrect permissions on source files
@@ -224,7 +224,9 @@ stylelint:
         using: run-task
         cwd: '{checkout}'
         command: >
-            cp -r /build/node_modules_eslint node_modules &&
+            cp -r $MOZ_FETCHES_DIR/node_modules node_modules &&
+            ln -s ../tools/lint/eslint/eslint-plugin-mozilla node_modules &&
+            ln -s ../tools/lint/eslint/eslint-plugin-spidermonkey-js node_modules &&
             ./mach commlint -v -l stylelint -f treeherder
             -f json:/builds/worker/mozlint.json
             comm/*
@@ -233,6 +235,7 @@ stylelint:
     fetches:
         toolchain:
             - linux64-node
+            - node-modules
 
 trojan-source:
     description: Trojan Source attack - CVE-2021-42572
diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/toolchain/kind.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/toolchain/kind.yml
index fef3899b438..079035aa4e9 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/toolchain/kind.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/toolchain/kind.yml
@@ -65,6 +65,7 @@ reference-tasks:
     - macosx64-sdk-toolchain
     - macosx64-x64-compiler-rt-18
     - mingw32-rust
+    - node-modules
     - nsis

     - sysroot-i686-linux-gnu
